scenario.summary: The Turla-linked Cereal campaign targets government Exchange servers, utilizing a modular .NET toolset that operates without external C&C infrastructure by co-opting the victim server as a passive listener. The toolset intercepts mail by injecting into the EdgeTransport.exe process to hijack transport agents and uses specialized .NET tradecraft, such as native image cache abuse, to maintain stealthy execution.

hunt.name: Turla CerealNeuron Passive Exchange Backdoor
hunt.description: This hunt targets CerealNeuron, a component of Turla's Cereal toolset. Unlike traditional implants that beacon out, CerealNeuron acts as a passive listener within IIS on a compromised Exchange server. It monitors incoming web requests for specific encrypted payloads directed at sub-paths in /owa/, /autodiscover/, or /activesync/ namespaces. The hunt identifies Exchange assets, searches for hits against known malicious URIs, and baselines external source traffic to find anomalous access patterns that may indicate rotated command paths where standard indicators have changed.

config.scoping_notes: Focus on Internet-facing Microsoft Exchange servers. Use the scoping query to narrow the estate, then refine with the scope_hosts parameter if specific servers are suspected.
config.beyond_detection: Simple URI matching is brittle and easily bypassed by path rotation. This hunt combines indicator matching with a behavioral baseline of source IPs accessing Exchange namespaces, requiring an analyst to weigh source rarity against requested paths.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%exchange server%'
config.description: Identify the hosts running Microsoft Exchange Server to provide a narrow scope for application-layer traffic analysis.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames hosting Exchange services. Silence means no managed hosts are running Exchange Server according to inventory.

primitive_config.label: Identify Exchange Server Assets
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%exchange server%'
primitive_config.expected: A list of hostnames hosting Exchange services. Silence means no managed hosts are running Exchange Server according to inventory.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_path, src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, status_code, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{cereal_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_path) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Match URI paths reported as C2 endpoints for the passive backdoor exactly.
config.expected_signal: Direct matches indicate an external entity requested a path used for C2. Silence confirms these specific paths were not observed.

primitive_config.label: Match Known CerealNeuron Paths
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_path, src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, status_code, time FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (instr(',' || '{{cereal_paths}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(url_path) || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Direct matches indicate an external entity requested a path used for C2. Silence confirms these specific paths were not observed.

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, url_path, COUNT(*) AS req_count, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/owa/%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/autodiscover/%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/microsoft-server-activesync/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, url_path HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC, req_count DESC
config.description: Stack-count source IPs accessing Exchange namespaces to find operators maintaining a consistent source profile on non-standard paths.
config.expected_signal: Outlier IPs or User Agents targeting only one or two servers. Legitimate remote access typically spans a broader set of hosts or correlates with known user populations.

primitive_config.label: Baseline Rare Source Access
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, url_path, COUNT(*) AS req_count, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/owa/%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/autodiscover/%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '/microsoft-server-activesync/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip, user_agent, url_path HAVING host_count <= 2 ORDER BY host_count ASC, req_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: Outlier IPs or User Agents targeting only one or two servers. Legitimate remote access typically spans a broader set of hosts or correlates with known user populations.

config.objective: Determine if any Exchange server shows patterns of passive command reception, specifically hits on known Turla URIs or rare, single-host access to sensitive namespaces.

config.expected_signal: A host-by-host verdict classifying the activity as malicious, suspicious, or benign.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict citing specific rows, source IPs, and requested URIs.

config.instructions: Isolate the compromised Exchange server from the network. Do not reboot the server before capturing a memory dump, as the backdoor runs in volatile memory.

config.description: Verify the presence of malicious components in IIS processes and identify any staged data.
config.instructions: Acquire a memory dump of w3wp.exe. Search for suspicious .NET assemblies with unmanaged entry points. Inspect the file system for encrypted files under the Exchange installation directory that may indicate the presence of CerealHermit.

config.description: Document findings and update baseline data for future runs.
config.instructions: Record all suspicious source IPs and URIs. Update the organization's baseline for remote access to Exchange services. If hits were found, escalate to full incident response.
